messages.subject: save/load data on survey end
parts:
Hi all,
I am trying to establish a simple online survey system using shiny. Does anyone know how to save and load data on the survey end (instead of downloading files to the local machine) so answers from users are automatically recorded? For example, when a user has made a few multiple choices and click "save", his/her answer will be saved on the server and the data can be instantly retrieved when the user hit "load". Thanks!
